summary: The Proving Grounds Region is the Muramite Dominion’s elite training complex, where soldiers, constructs, and captives undergo lethal Discord trials.
history: Muramite engineers constructed the Proving Grounds as a proving site for elite soldiers.
The central arena served as the original training crucible.
Seven specialized trial chambers were added to test distinct combat disciplines.
Dragorn captives were forced into trials as living test subjects.
Discord pylons were installed to amplify lethality and destabilize combat.
The region became the gateway between the Wall of Slaughter and the Muramite Citadel.

trials.name: Trial of Endurance
trials.theme: attrition, stamina drain, and prolonged combat

trials.name: Trial of Adaptation
trials.theme: dynamic terrain shifts and adaptive combat
